text:
lina: quick drop — magnolia-11b-compact bring-up (3k sampled chat sessions). putting a short cost-vs-quality readout and a suggested rollout for product/GTN.

max: love it. headline numbers?

lina: snapshot: 
```
model: magnolia-11b-compact-int8
  p50: 210ms, p95: 530ms
  avg tokens/req: 380
  cost / 1M toks: $9.10
  GTN multi-turn: 0.78

model: magnolia-11b-compact-int6
  p50: 170ms, p95: 390ms
  avg tokens/req: 380
  cost / 1M toks: $16.70
  GTN multi-turn: 0.83
```

oren: ~45% cost reduction int8 vs int6, ~0.05 GTN drop. where are the deltas?

lina: regressions focused on:
- structured-output fidelity (table formatting, JSON-ish tool outputs)
- very low-temperature creative writing (few-shot persona prompts)
Short Q&A and single-turn completion roughly equal. Token-level hallucination unchanged.

priya: product question: we serve both mobile and desktop — any routing ideas to preserve UX?

lina: proposed policy: tiered routing + batching-aware rules
- Default: int8 for web/mobile low-latency flows.
- Route to int6 when: predicted structured output required OR context_tokens > 600 OR user_tier == enterprise.
- For mobile specifically: prefer int6 for sessions with >3 turns to avoid micro-regressions in follow-up coherence.

max: expected unit econ after rules?

lina: rough calc:
- all-int6 = $16.7 / 1M
- all-int8 = $9.1 / 1M
- mixed 65% int8 + 35% int6 => 0.65*9.1 + 0.35*16.7 = ~$11.95 / 1M (~28% savings vs all-int6)
- applying mobile-tier preference (assume 15% traffic pinned to int6) => ~$12.40 / 1M (~25.7% savings)

oren: monitoring/gating?

lina: checklist:
- Add GTN slice for "structured-output fidelity" + "few-shot persona" as must-pass.
- Nightly diff on canary traffic (canary vs prod control). Alert thresholds: GTN delta <= -0.025 OR structured-output parse failure rate increase > 1.5x.
- Shadow int8 responses for 72h on top-3 product flows before ramp beyond 20%.
- Immediate feature-flag rollback available.

deploy-bot: canary created: `magnolia-compact-mixed-canary` -> 0.05 default. Runbook: /rollout canary magnolia-compact 5% -> 30% over 10d.

priya: quick GTM blurb needed for deck.

lina: one-liner: "Magnolia-11b-compact int8 cuts per-token cost ~45% with a modest drop in structured-output fidelity; recommend a mixed routing policy to capture ~25-30% cost savings while keeping enterprise & structured-output traffic on the higher-fidelity int6."

max: please update model docs with the perf/quality table, routing examples, and the gating slices.

lina: will add per-slice CSV + short summary to the onboarding folder and hook GTN. raw logs available if someone wants to triage specific failures.

oren: also add an automated smoke test that parses JSON-like outputs and flags any schema drift during canary.

lina: added to checklist. will follow up with a short sample set for GTN. :thumbsup:

priya: scheduled 3pm sync with GTN/product to go over the plan.
